title: BARMM leaders to fund Mecca trip for poor Bangsamoro pilgrims

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Several members of the Bangsamoro Transition Authority (BTA) or the interim Bangsamoro Parliament have committed to funding at least 1,000 indigent Bangsamoro pilgrims on a religious journey to Mecca, Saudi Arabia, in November. The Bangsamoro Pilgrimage Authority (BPA) and 14 Members of Parliament (MPs), including Bangsamoro interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua, formalized their partnership for the 2026 Transitional Development Impact Fund (TDIF) Umrah Assistance. The Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) was signed at the Bajau Hall at the Bangsamoro Government Center here last Tuesday.
